name: Chummy assistant
description: The default loop. It asks you a question first if your request is unclear, then tries it straight away, with tools. Anything too big is broken into 5 or fewer steps, tried the same way. Every tool call is checked before it runs, every result and plan is checked, and the model keeps working notes as it goes. Failures are caught and reported instead of stopping the run.

params.format:
Conversation so far:
_INPUT1_

The user now says:
_INPUT2_

blocks.label: Clarify the request
blocks.comment: Asks you one question if the request is unclear.

blocks.label: Running exchange
blocks.comment: The system message includes {{notes}}, read fresh at every model call.

blocks.label: Next task
blocks.comment: Waits for the running exchange and the next task, so tasks go strictly in order.

blocks.label: Up to 5 steps
blocks.comment: New steps join the back of the queue: breadth-first.

links.label: the first task: the request itself

functions.name: Verify
functions.description: Writes a yes/no check question for an answer, then asks the model that question about it. Passed sends the answer on; Failed sends the reason. If a check can't run, the answer passes, so a failing model never blocks the work.

blocks.label: Write a check question
blocks.comment: A small model checks itself best with a question it wrote.

params.format:
Request: _INPUT1_

Answer: _INPUT2_

Question: _INPUT3_

Answer the question about the answer above. Start with YES or NO, then give one short reason.

blocks.label: Answer the check

params.system: Answer YES or NO first, then give one short reason.

blocks.comment: Must start with YES or NO.

blocks.label: Fallback question

params.format: Does this answer make sense given the request?

blocks.comment: If writing a question fails, use the standard one.

blocks.label: Pass if the check fails
blocks.comment: A check that can't run doesn't hold the work up.

notes.text: Verify: the model writes a yes/no question about an answer, then answers it. Passed sends the answer on; Failed sends the reason.

functions.name: Clarify the request
functions.description: Asks the model whether the request is clear enough. If not, asks you its one question, and adds your answer to the request. Any failure lets the request through unchanged.

blocks.label: Clear enough?

params.prompt:
_INPUT_

Is the user's latest request clear enough to act on? If it is, reply with only: CLEAR
If not, reply with the one short question you most need answered.
params.system: Reply with CLEAR or one short question.

blocks.comment: Replies CLEAR, or with one question.

blocks.label: Ask you

params.default_answer: No answer came. Use your best judgement and carry on.

blocks.comment: Waits up to an hour, then carries on without an answer.

params.format: No answer came. Use your best judgement and carry on.

blocks.label: Use as is
blocks.comment: If the check fails, the request goes on unchanged.

notes.text: Clarify runs once, before any work. Clear requests pass straight through; unclear ones get one question to you.

functions.name: Check the tool call
functions.description: Before a tool call runs, the model checks that it makes sense and is safe for the task. Approved calls go on to Run tool; others are declined with the reason, which goes back to the model. If the check can't run, the call is approved (your own approvals still apply).

params.format:
Task: _INPUT1_

The next step calls a tool:
_INPUT2_

Is this call sensible and safe for the task? Start with YES or NO, then give one short reason.

blocks.label: Sensible and safe?

params.system: Answer YES or NO first, then give one short reason.

blocks.comment: Must start with YES or NO.

blocks.label: Decline the call
blocks.comment: Answers the call with “Not run: <reason>”, so the model can try something else.

functions.name: Update the notes
functions.description: After each result or plan, the model rewrites its working notes ({{notes}}), which every attempt and plan sees. If that fails, the old notes stay.

blocks.label: Rewrite the notes

params.prompt:
Your working notes so far:
{{notes}}

What just happened:
_INPUT_

Rewrite the working notes for the rest of the work: key facts found, decisions made, what is done and what is left. At most 10 short lines. Write only the notes.

blocks.comment: Sees the notes so far and what just happened.

blocks.label: Save the notes
blocks.comment: Read anywhere as {{notes}}.

blocks.label: Note the failure
blocks.comment: Keeps the old notes; just remembers what went wrong.

functions.name: Attempt the task
functions.description: The model tries the task, calling tools (each checked first) as often as it needs, or asks you a question. Its result is checked with Verify. If it says the task is too big, or the result fails its check, the exchange goes out of Breakdown instead. A failed model call becomes a short message.

blocks.label: Try the task

params.system:
Do the user's latest task now. Use a tool if it helps. If you can do it, give the result in a few sentences. If it is too big to finish in one go, reply with only: TOO BIG
If you can't go on without the user's input, reply with only: QUESTION: and your question.

Your working notes:
{{notes}}

blocks.comment: Can use tools (all three switches must allow each one), answer, say TOO BIG, or ask a QUESTION.

blocks.label: Check the tool call
blocks.comment: Every call is checked before it runs.

blocks.label: Run tool
blocks.comment: Tool errors go back to the model, which can try again.

blocks.label: Ask you

params.default_answer: No answer came. Use your best judgement and carry on.

blocks.comment: Waits up to an hour, then carries on without an answer.

params.format: No answer came. Use your best judgement and carry on.

blocks.label: Task exchange
blocks.comment: Re-sends the task's exchange each time a question or failure needs it.

params.format: My attempt didn't pass this check: _INPUT_

blocks.label: Explain the failure
blocks.comment: If the model call fails, say so and move on.

notes.text: The work cycle: Try the task ⇄ Check the tool call ⇄ Run tool, until the model answers. A QUESTION: answer goes to you, then back to the model with your answer.
Failures don't stop the run: a failed model call becomes “I couldn't finish this task”, and the work moves on.

functions.name: Plan smaller steps
functions.description: Plans 5 or fewer smaller steps for a task that's too big, checks the plan with Verify, and plans once more, with the reason, if it fails.

params.format:
_INPUT_

This is too big to do in one go. Break it into 5 or fewer smaller steps, as broad or as narrow as each needs to be. Write only the steps, one per line, numbered like:
1. First step
2. Second step

blocks.label: Plan smaller steps
blocks.comment: Sees the running exchange, including the working notes.

params.format:
I broke this task into smaller steps:
_INPUT_

That plan didn't pass this check: _INPUT_

Write a better plan in the same format.

blocks.label: Plan again
blocks.comment: Only once, so a plan can't loop.

blocks.label: Explain the failure
blocks.comment: If planning fails, say so; no steps are added.

notes.text:
Chummy assistant

1. Clarify: one question to you if the request is unclear.
2. Attempt: try each task now, with checked tool calls; ask you if stuck.
3. Plan: tasks that are too big become up to 5 steps, done breadth-first.
4. Notes: after every result and plan, the model updates its working notes ({{notes}}).

Double-click a function block to see inside.
Each task pairs with the running exchange at Next task, so the model always sees the goal and everything done so far.
